svg.title: Orchestrator, specialist fleet and shared substrate
svg.desc: Three-column agentic architecture: five input channels on the left connect to a central orchestrator and specialist agent fleet, which connect to five substrate planes on the right (memory, skills and MCP, models, compute, and data), above a six-stage build-to-improve lifecycle dock.
svg.text: Human operators, web apps and automations route through a central orchestrator and specialist agents backed
by durable memory, MCP skills and multi-cloud compute.
Event-sourced JSONL vaults, D1, R2 & vector recall
Typed tool servers, brand packs & domain playbooks
Claude, Gemini, OpenAI & open-weight model routing
Cloudflare Workers, Vercel, Supabase & OCI clusters
Derived from the Starlight and FrankX multi-agent orchestration reference blueprint.
